CustomObject.description: The TurboSign Envelope tracks one document sent for e-signature through TurboSign. It records the TurboDocx Document Id (external ID), the related record and Opportunity, Status, send and completion timestamps, and the signed document. Roll-ups count recipients, events, and reminders; formulas compute days to sign and days outstanding. Commonly used for signature lifecycle tracking and reporting.
CustomObject.label: TurboSign Envelope
